problem: Jobs completion could emit crm.invoice.create readiness, but the cleaning lifecycle had no certified continuity layer for invoice inputs, duplicate suppression, authoritative invoice receipt, and governed payment reconciliation readiness.
resolution: Added an authority-neutral cleaning invoice/payment readiness planner that reuses existing crm.invoice.create and finance.payment.reconcile workflows, requires QA-ready completion, blocks incomplete invoice inputs, suppresses authoritative duplicate invoices, and exposes payment reconciliation only after an authoritative invoice receipt.
